title: feat: add name attribute and class "actor-line" to line
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

- [x] The actors have unique names so adding a name field to the line connecting the actors for easier identification in SVG nodes.
- [x] Additionally fixes a bug - `actor-line` class was never added to the line as it was getting overridden so now that's fixed as well

cc @sidharthv96 

```html
<line id="actor11" x1="714" y1="5" x2="714" y2="621" class="actor-line 200" stroke-width="0.5px" stroke="#999" name="4"></line>
```


## :straight_ruler: Design Decisions

similar to https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/pull/5284, this is adding a unique identifier for line nodes connecting the actors

comments.author: aloisklink
comments.body:
> However, I am happy to keep it as the one in production as well.

It might be better to keep the color as it is, even if it does look slightly worse, since this bug has been around so long that people are probably used to the current colour.

Plus, due to the way this repo has GitHub permissions set up, if the visual regression tests show changes, we need an @mermaid-js admin to merge this PR. Otherwise, I can merge it myself without waiting for anybody else to review :smile:

comments.author: aloisklink
comments.body:
@ad1992, for this PR, do you want to apply the above diff (either manually or by copying to a `.diff` file and running `git apply my-diff-file.diff`?) to prevent any visual changes? If there are no visual changes for this PR, I can merge it without waiting for anybody else. It's probably easier to make the visual changes in another PR, since that will require admin permissions from another reviewer. I'd imagine we'd probably also want to pick a setting that looks good in all of the [built-in mermaid themes](https://mermaid.js.org/config/theming.html#available-themes), e.g.
default neutral dark forest base
```mermaid --- config: theme: default --- sequenceDiagram Alice->>+John: Hello John, how are you? ``` ```mermaid --- config: theme: neutral --- sequenceDiagram Alice->>+John: Hello John, how are you? ``` ```mermaid --- config: theme: dark --- sequenceDiagram Alice->>+John: Hello John, how are you? ``` ```mermaid --- config: theme: forest --- sequenceDiagram Alice->>+John: Hello John, how are you? ``` ```mermaid --- config: theme: base --- sequenceDiagram Alice->>+John: Hello John, how are you? ```
